title: AI triage on the service desk is now assumed, not a differentiator
angle: Worth writing about because the interesting part is not that AI triages tickets, it is that the measurable win was consistency rather than raw speed.
keyPoints: AI on the service desk is now treated as a core part of the product rather than a feature to shop for.
Reported time to resolution for tickets using AI automation ran between 2.4 and 6.3 hours across a five month window.
That band held even as ticket volume grew, so the predictability is arguably the bigger result than the speed.
The distinction worth asking vendors about is whether AI features are surface level or actually resolve routine requests end to end.
Knowledge management has moved from a supporting practice to a primary lever for cutting ticket volume and improving first contact resolution.
